# Ai-Team — .NET Agent Toolkit

**New here? Run `/at-status` first** — it scans your project and recommends exactly which commands to use next.

## Commands

| Command | Description | When to Use |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| `/at-status` | Project diagnosis — maturity, gaps, recommended next step | Start of every session |
| `/at-plan` | Plan a story end-to-end (spec → tasks → validation) | Before writing any code |
| `/at-apply` | Apply a planned spec to the codebase | After `/at-plan` produces a spec |
| `/at-validate` | Multi-discipline review of a spec or existing code | Before merging, or on demand |
| `/at-context-sync` | Reconcile `CONTEXT.md` drift after a session | After significant changes |
| `/at-context-grill` | Deep interview to refresh project context | When stack or architecture changes |
| `/at-arch-improve` | Architecture improvement suggestions + ADR generation | When architecture needs evolution |
| `/at-meta-improve` | Improve a project-local skill | When a skill needs refinement |
| `/at-meta-teach` | Teach the AI a new convention or pattern | When a new pattern emerges |
